overview_description.description: Skydropx is a logistics management system for e-commerce and retail in LATAM. It helps reduce time and costs by centralizing all the shipments in one place to provide better customer service. Skydropx helps ship postage at feasible rates, tracks and integrates shipments into the user's shopping cart in real-time using API, and utilizes a network of independent drivers for fast delivery, enabling users to send and receive parcels in a simplified manner.

about_short_description.short_description: Skydropx is a logistics management system designed to manage and regulate shipments.

product.name: Shipments Management Platform
product.description: A platform to centralize, create, and track shipments from multiple sources in one place, integrating with eCommerce and marketplaces.

product.name: SMARTX
product.description: An algorithm-based tool that predicts and evaluates the best shipping options based on cost, time, and effectiveness.

product.name: RADAR
product.description: A system to centralize, automate, and notify shipment tracking and status updates to customers and internal teams.

product.name: Shipping Rate Quoter
product.description: A dynamic tool to calculate shipping costs including weight and zone surcharges for national and international shipments.

product.name: Order and Shipment Generation
product.description: A service to synchronize orders from various sales channels and generate shipping labels in bulk with tracking capabilities.

product.name: Customer Support and Issue Resolution
product.description: Centralized support service to manage and resolve shipment-related issues and inquiries.
